meta.title: Greta Studio — Fast Batch Watermarking & Branding for Photographers
meta.description: Protect, sign, and brand thousands of photos in seconds with native Rust speed. Built for Windows and macOS photographers.

hero.badge: v1.6.0 · Native Rust Engine for Windows & macOS
hero.titleStart: Protect & brand thousands of photos in
hero.subtitle: Built for event, sports, and wedding photographers. Smart auto-contrast signatures, anti-theft proofing patterns, and sponsor ribbons—running 100% offline on your machine.
hero.metaNote: No subscription · Free 5-photo batch trial · macOS Universal & Windows 64-bit

features.title: Everything you need to deliver protected galleries fast
features.subtitle: Zero cloud uploads, zero browser lag. Native multi-core Rust processing with a 60 FPS live studio canvas.

signature.title: Auto-Contrast Smart Signatures
signature.description: Upload your light and dark logos once. Greta reads corner luminance on every photo and picks the crispest contrast automatically.

pattern.title: Anti-Theft Proofing Patterns
pattern.description: Diagonal tiled watermarks with subtle contrast halos and optional filename ID stamps so clients can pick proofs without cropping.

ribbon.title: Event Sponsor Ribbons
ribbon.description: Add up to 6 sponsor logos in a clean top or bottom bar for marathons, tournaments, and corporate coverage.

geometry.title: Shortest-Edge & Split Orientations
geometry.description: Logos scale proportionally across horizontal and vertical shots automatically, with optional custom overrides per orientation.

rust.title: Parallel Rust + Rayon Core
rust.description: Process full weddings or sports tournaments across all CPU cores with Lanczos3 sharpness and zero quality loss.

offline.title: Offline-First Hybrid Licensing
offline.description: Shoot in remote venues with confidence. Cryptographic Ed25519 verification works offline for 30 days between check-ins.

pricing.title: Pay once. Own your workflow.
pricing.subtitle: No monthly subscriptions. Try Greta Studio free for as long as you like, then unlock unlimited batches with a one-time license.

trial.name: Free Trial
trial.description: Test the full studio interface and export speed on your own photos.
features: Up to 5 photos per batch export

pro.name: Greta Studio Pro
pro.description: Lifetime license for independent photographers working across desktop and laptop.

studio.name: Studio Pack
studio.description: Built for photography agencies, multi-shooter teams, and live event crews.
